text_en: My son loves this toy, he hasn't put it down for two days ❤️
It's okay for the price.
Not bad, it does the job.
I really love this moisturiser, it hydrates my skin without making it greasy. The scent is light too, I recommend it.
The puzzle pieces fit together well and the colours are bright. My daughter and I worked on it all weekend ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
product is nice but the box arrived crushed, i was going to give it as a gift, so embarrassing. at least the seller apologised
It runs small, order one size up.
the translation of this book is terrible, the sentences are jumbled and make no sense. if there's a carefully translated edition, buy that one

The storybook is a bit long for little kids, there's too much text on every page. The pictures are lovely though, my daughter tells her own story just by looking at them 😊 Still, I'd say it was worth it.
The pots have no drainage holes, I drilled them myself. Other than that, the size and colour are nice.
The mascara clumps, it makes my lashes look like spider legs. Putting it on is torture, not fun, total waste of money. It also stung my eyes badly when I took it off in the evening 😡
After one week the headphones stopped working on one side. Still no word from the seller. If anyone has the same problem, message me at 0555 000 12 34 and let's complain together.
The coat I bought came in a darker colour than in the picture. The fabric is thick and keeps you warm, but the zip is a bit stiff.
awful, sent it back
They still haven't sent the invoice. If the seller sees this review, please send it to mehmet.y@example.com, I've been waiting for two weeks.
Great product 👍
this thing is awesome 😂😂

I used these earbuds for exactly one month and I'm disappointed 😤 The sound was fine for the first week, but then the left side started crackling. The Bluetooth connection keeps dropping too, especially when my phone is in my pocket. The lid of the charging case has come loose as well. You can find much better for this price, I've started the return 👎

I'm writing about the hair dryer. It's powerful, it dries my long hair in half the time my old one took. It has three heat settings and two speeds, and the cool-shot button works too. I don't know if the ion technology really reduces static, but my hair frizzes less than before. The downside is the weight; my wrist gets tired when I hold it for a long time. It's also very loud, I wake everyone up when I use it early in the morning. When I tried to register it for the warranty the website had a problem, so I called the service line. They called me back from +90 555 000 12 34 and we finished the registration on the phone. I was happy with the service, and the product is good overall.

I bought a school bag for my daughter, she's starting first grade 🎒 It said it had orthopaedic back support, and it really does hug her back well, and the straps are padded. The compartments are very practical, the water bottle pocket is on the side and she can reach it easily. The colour is exactly like the photo, a pink-to-purple fade, my daughter loved it 💜 But after two months the zip pull broke off, so we put a key ring on instead. They said the material was waterproof, but the notebooks inside got a bit wet in the rain. It's okay for the price, but next year we'll look for something sturdier. Shipping was fast and the packaging was careful 📦

i bought this phone for my mum, she's elderly so i wanted something with a big screen and simple. the screen really is big, she can read easily once the text is enlarged. it's loud and the speaker is clear. the camera is mediocre but she hardly takes photos anyway. the battery lasts two days, which is great for us. no charger in the box, i didn't know that, had to buy one separately. i did the setup, removed the useless apps, and now it runs really fast. my mum is very happy and so am i. they just should have mentioned the charger thing in the description

I've been using this microwave for about three months and can now give a detailed review. First the good points: it heats evenly, the middle of the food doesn't stay cold. Thanks to the grill function I can make things like toasties and pastries crispy too, which is a big plus for me. The preset programmes are handy, especially defrost. The door closes softly and the inside light is bright enough.
Now the bad points: the end beep is very loud and can't be turned off, it wakes everyone up when you use it at night. The outer casing shows fingerprints badly, you have to wipe it all the time. The turntable sometimes comes off its track and rattles. The plug cable is short too, I had to use an extension lead. The manual is only in foreign languages, the Turkish part is just two pages. Despite all this, I recommend it for the price.

I wanted to use the product for two months before writing, because reviewing on first impressions isn't fair. The robot vacuum does very well on both carpet and parquet, and it picks up enough hair for a home with two cats. The mapping feature got the floor plan right.
As for the downsides: it often gets stuck on door thresholds, it loves swallowing cables, and the dust bin is small so you have to empty it every day. The app sometimes loses the connection. I'd call it mid-range for value for money.

The print quality of the book is much better than I expected. The pages are thick, the text is sharp and the binding is solid. But there was no protection at all in the shipping package, and one corner of the book arrived crushed. I told the seller, they apologised but didn't offer an exchange. Great content, bad packaging.

I ordered the food bowl and water fountain set for my two cats 🐱🐱 The fountain runs very quietly, you can't hear it from the bedroom at night at all. The filter is easy to change and spare filters are cheap. My cats never liked drinking water before, now they sit by it all the time watching the running water. The food bowl is ceramic and heavy, so it doesn't tip over; but the opening is a bit narrow, and when my big cat eats, its whiskers touch the edges, which bothers it. The fountain's pump stopped once in the third week, it worked again after I took it apart and cleaned it. I recommend cleaning it once a week. Four stars overall, I'd recommend it to cat owners 😊

I'd like to share my thoughts on the ironing board I ordered. As stated in the listing, the height is adjustable and it has a fairly wide surface. The cover is heat resistant and lets steam through well. However, I think one of the legs has a manufacturing defect; the board wobbles slightly even on a flat floor. I fixed the problem for now by sticking felt underneath. The iron rest is a bit small for our iron. Because it's thin when folded, it can easily be stored behind a door. Given the price it's an acceptable product, but more care should be taken with quality control.

I'm writing this review to inform other buyers about the delivery and installation of the washing machine I bought. After I placed the order, the seller said delivery would be within three working days; however, the product arrived a full eleven days later. I saw with my own eyes the delivery company drop the box while unloading it from the van. When we opened the box, there was a clear dent in the side panel. I asked for a damage report to be written up; the driver refused at first, then agreed when I insisted.
As for the machine itself, it runs quietly, the spin performance is good and the energy use is low. The programmes are easy to understand, the quick wash really finishes in thirty minutes, and the door lock is reassuring for child safety. However, because of the dent I asked for a replacement and the process is still ongoing. Four stars for the product, one for the service.

i bought this dumbbell set to work out at home, i just don't have time to go to the gym anymore. the weights are adjustable, there are two big and four small plates. the locking nuts are solid, they never came loose during a workout. the grips are knurled so they don't slip out of my hand. but be warned, it arrived in a very damaged box, the edge of one of the plates was broken. the seller asked for a photo, i sent it, and three days later they sent a new one, i'll give them credit for that. the coating on the plates has a slight smell for the first few weeks but it goes away. i suggest putting a mat underneath so they don't scratch the parquet when you put them down. a good start at this price for anyone who wants to do strength training at home

The kettle turned out exactly how I wanted. It boils water very fast, the lid opens with one button, and since the inside is steel it doesn't leave a smell. Its only flaw is that the cable is a bit short, other than that I recommend it with confidence.

I bought the smartwatch as a gift for my partner, who loves it 🎁 The step counter, heart rate and sleep tracking work quite accurately. The screen is easy to read even in sunlight. The battery doesn't last ten days as advertised, but it does six or seven days, and we're fine with that. The app isn't in Turkish, which is a bit annoying, but you get used to it. The strap is soft and doesn't make your wrist sweat 👍

I'm reviewing the desk. The assembly instructions are really poor, the pictures are tiny and some steps aren't shown at all. Two of us spent almost three hours on it. One screw hole had also been drilled wrong at the factory, and we had to redrill it. Once it's built the desk is sturdy and doesn't wobble, and the top looks scratch resistant. Still, a product at this price shouldn't have this many problems.

wanted to write about the kids' bike. when it came out of the box some parts were missing, there was no bag of screws for example. the seller sent them separately but we waited 5 days, my son kept asking every day when he could ride it. once built it's really sturdy and light. the training wheels go on and come off easily. bright colours too. if it weren't for the missing parts i'd give it 5 stars

trainers, tracksuit bottoms and a t-shirt came in the same order, so instead of writing three separate reviews i'll write them all here. the trainers are true to size, comfortable, but the white part gets dirty quickly. the tracksuit bottoms are soft, there's a drawstring at the waist, easy to adjust. the ankle cuffs are a bit tight but they'll probably loosen over time. the t-shirt is a letdown though, it shrank in the first wash and the neck got baggy. i washed everything at 30 degrees so it's not my fault. shipping took four days, packaging was good. all in all i recommend the trainers and the tracksuit bottoms, definitely don't buy the t-shirt, for the same money you can get two better t-shirts somewhere else

Hi, I bought these to replace the wireless headphones I'd been using for a long time, and I'd like to compare them 🎧 The sound quality is clearly better; the bass is full and the highs don't crackle. The active noise cancelling drowns out most of the engine noise even on the metro, which really surprised me. The microphone is mediocre though, on phone calls people say I sound far away. The ear cushions are soft, but my ears get sweaty after two hours. It's nice that they fold up and come with a hard carrying case. One charge lasts about thirty hours, and there's fast charging too 🔋 You can adjust the equaliser in the app. In short, great for listening to music, but people who make a lot of calls might want to consider another model.

I'd been looking for a decent desk lamp for my desk for a long time, my eyes were getting really tired in the evenings. I've had this lamp for about a month now and overall I'm happy with it.
It has three colour temperatures and five brightness levels. Working with warm white in the evening has really eased my eyes, while cool white in the morning feels more productive. The touch button is sensitive, sometimes I touch it by accident and turn it off.
The arm is flexible, I can set it to any angle, but after a while it slowly droops, tightening the screw fixed it. The base is heavy so there's no risk of it tipping over, which is good.
The USB charging port is a small but handy detail, I charge my phone there at night. The cable is a bit short though, I had to use an extension.
Shipping took two days, it was well protected with foam inside the box. My old lamp had a single light and flickered, there's no comparison. Nice product for the price, I recommend it.

After many years with a capsule machine, I decided to switch to a semi-automatic espresso machine with a built-in grinder. I'm writing this review after two months of daily use, especially for people like me who are thinking of making the switch.
Learning curve: In the first week I poured half the coffees I made down the sink, to be honest. Finding the balance between grind size, dose and tamp pressure takes patience. I learned from general guides online which setting to change when the coffee came out sour or bitter. By the end of the second week I was getting consistent, balanced shots.
Grinder: The built-in grinder has enough steps, but even on the finest settings I couldn't get some beans as fine as I wanted. Coffee grounds scatter around the chamber while grinding, so every morning I clean up with a small brush.
Steam wand: Powerful, it makes milk foam for one person in half a minute. My latte art attempts are still just shapeless hearts, but the texture is really good.
Compared with the capsule machine: The capsule machine is far ahead for speed and cleanliness, you just pressed a button and that was it. With this machine you need to set aside five or ten minutes every morning. But the taste isn't even comparable; and in the long run whole beans are much cheaper than capsules.
Maintenance: It needs a weekly backflush and monthly descaling. The water tank is large and comes out from the front.
Delivery: The box was very heavy, the delivery company left it at the door. The package also contained a tamper and a milk jug, but the plastic tamper is poor quality, so I bought a metal one.
Verdict: If you see coffee as a ritual and can take the time to learn, it's a great choice. Not suitable for people who want a quick coffee in the morning rush.
Extra info: The machine takes about twenty minutes to fully heat up so that the group head warms up too; I use a smart plug to turn it on before I wake up, and this simple fix saved my morning routine.

Buying a corner sofa was a big decision for us because our living room is small and the wrong choice could ruin the whole room. My partner and I measured for weeks, we marked out where the sofa would go on the floor with masking tape, the kids played on the tape and all that, anyway, let's not get sidetracked.
After we ordered they said production would take four weeks, it came in the fifth week. I called the seller once in between, they politely gave me an update, no complaints there. The delivery team was two people, they brought the pieces in separately and put them together in the living room, it took half an hour. They also took the packaging away with them, which I really liked, because when we bought our old sofa we were stuck with the cardboard for a week.
I have mixed feelings about the comfort. Lying on the long side is great, a real paradise on Sunday afternoons. But the corner part is a bit deep, whoever sits there can't sit up straight and needs a cushion behind them. The cushion filling was very puffy in the first week, it has settled a bit now, but no sagging.
The fabric is soft and the colour came in exactly the shade we wanted. But it tends to shed, when you sit on it in dark clothes little fibres stick to you. I also noticed a small stitching flaw in the fabric on the first day, I sent a photo and the seller sent a repair team, they fixed it in ten minutes.
Our old sofa was a two-seater plus an armchair, it took up a lot of space in the living room. This corner sofa actually seats more people but somehow feels like it takes up less space, interesting.
To sum up: A good product, careful service and delivery, a few small flaws. I recommend it for small living rooms if you measure carefully.
One more thing: The cushion covers have zips but washing isn't recommended, it says dry clean only. That's a bit of a worry for homes with small kids, we bought a sofa throw. After two months of use the fabric hasn't pilled and the colour hasn't faded either, even though it's next to the window.

I've been using the robot vacuum for six weeks 🤖 This will be a long review, so I'm writing it in points.
Mapping: It mapped the house quite accurately on its first run. In the app you can split the rooms and name them; I set it to clean the kitchen every day and the bedrooms every other day.
Cleaning: It picks up cat hair really well 🐈 The side brush does well in corners but gets caught on rug fringes, so I made the living room rug a no-go zone.
Mopping: The mopping feature is more like a damp cloth, it doesn't remove sticky stains. Fine for everyday dust.
Obstacle detection: It gets caught on cables and socks, so you need to pick things up off the floor before running it. This has actually made me keep the house tidier, a hidden benefit 😅
Battery: It does our ninety square metre home on one charge, then goes back and recharges.
Noise: Acceptable in normal mode, quite loud in max mode.
Delivery: Took three days, and the box also had a spare brush and filter.
I still use my old upright vacuum once a week for a deep clean. The robot doesn't fully replace it, but it seriously cuts down the daily work. Four and a half stars ⭐
The cleaning history in the app is a nice touch too, you can see how many square metres it vacuumed on which day. Once, after an update, the map was deleted and it had to map again, which was annoying, but it relearned it in half an hour.

Took the tent camping twice last month, here are my first impressions ⛺ I managed to set it up on my own in about fifteen minutes, the poles are colour coded so they're hard to mix up. It says two-person but with two adults and bags it's a bit cramped, if you want to be comfortable I'd suggest getting the bigger size.
On the second trip we got caught in a downpour at night 🌧️ The inside stayed completely dry, there were just a few drops at the bottom of the door zip. At this price that's really beyond what I expected. Thanks to the vents it didn't fog up inside in the morning.
There aren't quite enough pegs, extra pegs are a must in windy spots. The carry bag is also sewn to the exact size, folding the tent and getting it back in is a real test of patience 😤
Shipping took three days, the box was intact. My old tent was heavy and let water in, compared with that I'm very happy. I can happily recommend it for weekend campers.

I bought this novel on a friend's recommendation; my friend said it was one of the best books they'd ever read, and although I don't normally read this genre, I thought I'd give it a chance. I've just finished it and there's so much in my head that I don't know where to start, so forgive me if this is a bit scattered.
The book tells the story of three generations of a family living in a coastal town. The first chapters are from the grandmother's point of view, then it moves to her daughter, then to her granddaughter. These switches confused me at first; I had to go back a few pages to work out who was speaking. But then I got used to it, and seeing in each part how the same event was remembered by someone different was incredibly enjoyable.
The grandmother's chapters are, I think, the strongest part of the book. The language is a bit old-fashioned, full of long sentences, but as you read it feels like someone is really sitting across from you telling the story. The granddaughter's chapters are shorter and sharper, city life, work stress and so on, and to be honest those felt a bit clichéd to me.
In the middle of the book, for about a hundred pages, almost nothing happens, just descriptions: the sea, the wind, kitchen smells. At one point I thought about giving up, and I didn't pick it up for two weeks. Then on a rainy Sunday I started again and finished the last third in one sitting. The last chapter made me cry, I admit it.
There's one thing I have to mention about the printing: some pages have typesetting errors, and in two places lines are repeated. The cover design is beautiful though, it stands out on the bookshelf.
It arrived from the shop I ordered from in three days, and they included a free bookmark. All in all, a wonderful novel for patient readers. Not for those who expect a fast-moving plot.
After reading it I passed it on to my mother, she finished it in a week too and said she saw her own mother in the grandmother's chapters. Maybe that's the book's real strength: it reminds everyone of something from their own family.

I bought the electric scooter for commuting to work; on paper it looked perfect. My conclusion after a month: it's okay, but it didn't live up to my expectations.
The ad says twenty-five kilometres on a single charge. With my weight and the city's hills, the real range doesn't go beyond fifteen kilometres. My daily round trip is twelve kilometres, so I have to charge it every evening, and charging takes five hours.
It's actually fun to ride. Acceleration is smooth, the brakes respond well, and the front light is bright enough in the dark. Because it folds, I can keep it next to my desk at the office.
But the solid tyres pass every bump on rough roads straight to your wrists. On a cobbled street my hands literally go numb. Also, in the second week the rear mudguard screw came loose and started rattling; I tightened it myself.
It's also too heavy for a folding vehicle; carrying it up and down the metro stairs is a real ordeal.
Delivery was fast and the seller answered my questions politely. The product isn't bad, the advertising is just exaggerated. If you live in a flat city and have a short commute, it's a reasonable choice.
I'd also like to add something about safety: the rear brake light is small and almost invisible during the day, so I fitted an extra flashing light. Instead of a horn there's a bell and it's very weak, nobody hears it in traffic. Be sure to buy protective gear like a helmet and knee pads separately, nothing comes with the product.

I realised during this process how indecisive I am about mattresses. I researched and compared for months, finally bought this one, and honestly regretted it the first night, because it was much firmer than I expected. My partner, on the other hand, loved it from the first night, so there are two opinions in our house. It comes vacuum-packed in the box, and after opening it you need to wait a day for it to expand; we didn't know that and slept on it the first evening, which was a mistake. There was a slight smell too, we left the window open for two or three days and it went away.
After the second week, I don't know whether my body got used to it or the mattress softened, but my lower back pain in the mornings has eased, I have to say that. Our old mattress had sunk in the middle and we both kept rolling to the centre; there's no such problem now. The edge support is a bit weak, it sinks when you sit on the edge.
Delivery was quick, the courier carried it all the way upstairs and was polite. It says there's a trial period, but the return conditions are complicated, you need to read them. I don't think I'll return it, we've got used to it.

I did a lot of research before buying this car seat, because I didn't want to make a mistake with this. We've been using it for a month; my daughter is nine months old and about nine kilos.
Installation: It attaches to the anchor points in the car, and I installed it in ten minutes the first time. When the indicator on the side turns green you know it's fitted correctly, which gave me a lot of confidence. Still, I had someone who knows about car safety check it too, and everything was in place.
Use: The seat has a swivel base, so turning it towards the door to put the baby in is very easy on your back. With our old seat I had to bend over and reach in every time. The harness can be tightened with one hand, but the release button is set a bit deep, and I have to feel around for it.
Comfort: My daughter didn't fuss even on long journeys, and the recline angle is good for sleeping. The cover comes off and can be machine washed, though putting it back on is a bit of a struggle.
Downsides: It's very heavy, moving it from car to car is a hassle. It also takes up quite a lot of room in the back seat; we had to move the front passenger seat forward.
Delivery took two days, the box was intact. I'm very happy with it for safety and comfort, and if the weight isn't a problem for you, I recommend it.
Finally, the manual is very detailed and illustrated, showing the installation steps one by one. It clearly states up to what age and weight the seat can be used, which made it easier for us to plan ahead. We plan to use it for many years.

So I actually bought this laptop for university, meaning I don't do very heavy stuff on it, but I still wanted to say something because I've had loads of thoughts about it since the day I got it. The first setup took a while, what with updates and stuff an hour went by, anyway. The screen is nice, colours are vivid, really enjoyable for watching films. The keyboard is a bit soft in my opinion, I made lots of typos the first week but then I guess I got used to it. As for the battery I've never seen the time it says in the ad, with normal use it lasts six hours or so, which is enough for class but only just. The fan sometimes gets louder for no reason at all, once in the quiet library everyone looked at me, so embarrassing. My old laptop was much heavier, at least you can't feel this one in your bag, I really love that. The speakers are mediocre, headphones are a must. Shipping was fast, the box was intact, and the seller included a thank-you note, a nice touch. Overall not bad, makes sense for a student budget, but I think anyone expecting perfection will be disappointed.

I bought the sleeping bag for autumn camping and used it over the last month on three different trips, seven nights in total 🏕️ I'm very sceptical about temperature ratings, so I want to describe in detail how it performs in real conditions.
The label says the comfort temperature is five degrees. On the first trip the night temperature was around seven or eight degrees, and with a thin thermal liner I slept like a baby. On the second trip, by the lake, it dropped to two degrees ❄️ Honestly, my feet got cold there; with thick socks and a fleece I managed. So the label value is optimistic but not completely made up.
The mummy cut is a bit narrow at the shoulders, and as a side sleeper I was uncomfortable the first night. The hood drawcord works really well though, it can be adjusted so that only my face is uncovered.
The zip is two-way and has an anti-snag strip, so opening and closing it in the dark at night was no problem 👍 With the compression sack it packs down to about the size of a watermelon and fits easily in the bottom compartment of a backpack.
My old sleeping bag was a rectangular cut and very heavy; compared with that, this one is both lighter and warmer. But I could open up my old one and use it like a duvet, and this one doesn't have that kind of flexibility.
The washing instructions are a bit complicated: it has to be washed at a low temperature with a special detergent. I haven't washed it yet; I'll add here how the filling recovers after the first wash.
Shipping took four days, and a small storage bag came with the product; it says it shouldn't be kept compressed for long-term storage, a nice detail 🌲 I recommend it for spring and autumn camping; for winter, look at the next model up.
A small addition: The inside pocket of the bag is ideal for a phone and a torch, and it helped my phone battery drain more slowly in the cold at night 🔦

It's been about a month and a half since we bought the dishwasher. We're a family of four and run it at least once a day, sometimes twice at weekends, so I'd say it's had pretty heavy use.
The cleaning performance is very good overall. Even on the eco programme everything comes out sparkling except the bottoms of pots. It surprised me that the intensive programme even got most of the burnt-on bits off the oven tray. Drying is weak on plastic containers though, we have to dry them by hand every time. I think this is a general problem with this type of machine, but I still wanted to mention it.
The interior layout is flexible: the height of the upper basket can be adjusted, and the cutlery drawer is separate and wide. In our old machine the cutlery basket took up room on the bottom rack; now the bottom rack is left entirely for pots.
The noise level is low, you can hardly hear it from the living room. With the delay start feature we run it on the night tariff.
It was installed by the authorised service; getting an appointment took a week, but on the day they came they finished in half an hour. The corner of the box was crushed on delivery, but there was nothing wrong with the machine.
I recommend it; its only flaw is drying plastics.
A tip: When we set the rinse aid to the highest level, the water spots on the glasses disappeared completely; we struggled a bit in the first weeks because we didn't know that.

I bought the bike three weeks ago and since then I've cycled to work almost every day! It's twelve kilometres in total; I used to spend forty minutes on the bus, now I get there in thirty and start the day with much more energy.
The frame is light but feels solid. Gear changes are very smooth, and I can get up hills without struggling. The disc brakes feel reliable in wet weather too; once I had to brake suddenly and the bike stopped instantly.
It came out of the box half assembled; I fitted the handlebars and pedals, which took half an hour. Even so, after the first week I had a bike shop tune it, as the gears had slipped a little, and now it's perfect.
The saddle is a bit hard for me, it hurts on long rides, so I'm going to get a gel cover. Mudguards and a bell have to be bought separately.
Overall it turned out much better than I expected. I definitely recommend it for city riding, I wish I'd bought one sooner!

I'd had this book on my reading list for a long time, and the blurb on the back cover and the reviews had raised my expectations quite a lot. After finishing it I waited about a week, thinking it would be unfair if I wrote straight away.
Let me start with the good points: the language really flows, and I especially couldn't put down the first hundred pages. The parts describing small-town life are very vivid, and the characters' dialogue is natural. Since it isn't a translation, the wordplay works too.
But after the middle the story falls apart. The chapters given to side characters make you forget the main plot, and the last fifty pages feel rushed. A few questions I was curious about were never answered; that may be a deliberate choice, but it felt incomplete to me.
The print quality is good, the paper is easy on the eyes. It arrived on time, the corners were slightly crushed but I didn't mind.
Verdict: It's not a bad book, it's just not as good as the hype. Three stars.

Our sofa-buying adventure is a story in itself actually, so I'm going to write a bit long, sorry. We'd been looking for a new sofa for three months, our old one was twenty years old and the springs had started poking through. We went round the shops, looked online for hours, and finally ordered this three-seater.
Three weeks passed from order to delivery, they told us that at the start, no problem. On delivery day the team couldn't get the sofa through the door at first, they took the legs off and tried again, it finally went in but left a small mark on the wall, oh well.
I think the seating is great, neither too hard nor too soft. The fabric is sold as stain resistant, and it really is: We spilled coffee, wiped it with a damp cloth, no mark left. Our cat tried scratching it too, nothing has happened so far but we'll see over time.
The only problem is that the cushions keep slipping, you have to straighten them every evening. Also the colour looked lighter in the photos, it came a bit darker, could be a monitor difference but I'll mention it anyway.
In the end we're happy, guests liked it too. If you can live with the long delivery time, I recommend it.
And one small note: The sofa's legs are metal and can leave marks on parquet, we stuck felt under the legs. No felt came in the box, I wish the seller would include it. It doesn't turn into a bed, we knew that when we bought it, but anyone thinking of having guests sleep on it should be aware.

This blender turned my kitchen into a war zone, I don't know how to describe how angry I am. On the second use it started leaking from the bottom of the jug, the counter was flooded with fruit juice, and I pulled the plug in fear that liquid had got into the motor. I checked the seal, it was fitted properly.
I wrote to the seller, got an automatic message and was given an email address: destek.blender@example.com. I wrote there with photos, and it's been a week with no answer. The product page says powerful motor, leak-proof jug; both are a big lie. In ice-crush mode the motor gave off a smell like burnt plastic.
My old blender lasted ten years, this one was finished in two weeks. And it wasn't cheap either. The box and packaging are stylish, but I wish I felt the money had gone into the product instead.
I've opened a return request and I'll post the outcome here. For now I don't recommend it to anyone, stay away.
Update: Two days after writing this review I finally got a reply, asking me to send the product back by courier. They said I had to pay the shipping, and I objected. Whatever the outcome, this product isn't worth this much hassle.
